mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.title, s.summary, s.status, s.sale_status AS saleStatus, s.price_cents AS priceCents, s.currency, s.teacher_id AS teacherId, u.nickname AS teacherName, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS chapterCount, COUNT(DISTINCT v.id) AS videoCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ss.user_id) FROM t_student_series ss WHERE ss.series_id = s.id AND ss.status = 'ACTIVE') AS assignedStudentCount, s.published_at AS publishedAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM t_series s JOIN t_user u ON u.id = s.teacher_id LEFT JOIN t_series_chapter c ON c.series_id = s.id LEFT JOIN t_series_video v ON v.chapter_id = c.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.title, s.summary, s.status, s.sale_status, s.price_cents, s.currency, s.teacher_id, u.nickname, s.published_at, s.updated_at ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_series s JOIN t_user u ON u.id = s.teacher_id

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.summary, s.status, s.sale_status AS saleStatus, s.price_cents AS priceCents, s.currency, s.teacher_id AS teacherId, u.nickname AS teacherName, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM t_series s JOIN t_user u ON u.id = s.teacher_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT id, title, sort FROM t_series_chapter WHERE series_id = #{seriesId} ORDER BY sort, id

SELECT v.id, v.chapter_id AS chapterId, v.title, v.sort, v.media_status AS mediaStatus, v.duration_seconds AS durationSeconds, v.file_size_bytes AS fileSizeBytes, v.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM t_series_video v JOIN t_series_chapter c ON c.id = v.chapter_id WHERE c.series_id = #{seriesId} ORDER BY c.sort, c.id, v.sort, v.id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_series SET status = #{status}, published_at = NULL, sale_status = 'OFF_SALE', sale_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_series SET sale_status = #{saleStatus}, price_cents = #{priceCents}, sale_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id}
